title: sd-docs-lint repository settings
description: Read by `bin/sd-docs-lint` from `.github/sd-docs-lint.json` in the repository it lints. A sibling of `.github/sd-review.json` and `.github/sd-status.json`: it is in git, so a collaborator sees the decision in a diff, and a fresh clone carries it. An absent file means every default. A file that exists and is malformed takes no Jev reading, not even a local one, and says why in a note; it never fails the run, because the reading is advisory.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this schema. Ignored by the reader.

jev_claim_support.description: Opt this repository in to hosted Jev for rule 6's second reading, in which a model is asked whether each recorded citation's passage still supports the sentence citing it. Hosted Jev receives the citing sentence and the cited passage, both capped, so they leave the machine. Unset or false keeps the default: the local Kev answers through `jev --local-only`, and the prose stays on this machine (sd:2762). Only a JSON true opts in. `JEV_SD_DOCS_LINT=0` in the environment switches the reading off, local and hosted, and no environment variable can send prose to hosted Jev without this key.
